ffmpeg-core.js and ffmpeg-core.wasm are @ffmpeg/core 0.12.10 from npm, unchanged.

They are FFmpeg n5.1.4 built with x264, x265, libvpx, LAME, libogg, libtheora, libopus,
libvorbis, zlib, libwebp, FreeType, FriBidi, HarfBuzz, libass and zimg, and FFmpeg is
configured with --enable-gpl, so the files are under the GNU General Public License,
version 2 or later (COPYING).

The source of everything in them is attached to the first release of this repository
(https://github.com/syndicate-black-ops/video-converter/releases), with its SHA256:

The ffmpeg.wasm archive has the build scripts (Dockerfile, build/). The x264, x265 and
LAME archives are the ffmpegwasm copies the build uses; the others are the upstream
releases of the versions the Dockerfile names.
